source: Shared Insight text vectors (contract `Insight`; ruling 11-26: the plug-in's cleaner, plugin-owl src/clean/filter.ts checkText, and the server leak screen give the same answer). held = any hit. Split secrets (ruling 11-26): a hit on the normalised copy (U+200B-U+200F, U+2060, U+FEFF removed; space, hyphen or underscore runs between alphanumeric chunks of 4+ characters joined) also holds. Copied from backend-service 540c9724; the vectors after the backend set are added by the plug-in (word-identifier pass, word-shaped random fails, more split-secret cases) and need the server mirror (plugin-owl#66, Server mirror needed). Round 3 (plugin-owl aip-plugin-3): the injection phrase forms at the end also need the server mirror (the round-3 SendGrid and Slack shapes are built in tests/unit/cleaner.test.ts, so no key-shaped string sits in this file).
